quotes.en: Rule No.1: Never lose money. Rule No.2: Never forget rule No.1.
quotes.zh: 规则一：永远不要亏钱。规则二：永远不要忘记规则一。

quotes.en: Be fearful when others are greedy, and greedy when others are fearful.
quotes.zh: 别人贪婪时我恐惧，别人恐惧时我贪婪。

quotes.en: Price is what you pay; value is what you get.
quotes.zh: 价格是你付出的，价值是你得到的。

quotes.en: The stock market is a device for transferring money from the impatient to the patient.
quotes.zh: 股市是一种把钱从没耐心的人转移给有耐心的人的装置。

quotes.en: It takes 20 years to build a reputation and five minutes to ruin it.
quotes.zh: 建立声誉需要二十年，毁掉它只需五分钟。

quotes.en: The best time to plant a tree was 20 years ago. The second best time is now.
quotes.zh: 种一棵树最好的时间是二十年前，其次是现在。

quotes.en: We don't have to be smarter than the rest. We have to be more disciplined than the rest.
quotes.zh: 我们不必比别人更聪明，只需比别人更自律。

quotes.en: An investment in knowledge pays the best interest.
quotes.zh: 对知识的投资回报最高。

quotes.en: Beware of little expenses; a small leak will sink a great ship.
quotes.zh: 小心小额开支；小漏洞也能沉大船。

quotes.en: The market rewards discipline, not intelligence.
quotes.zh: 市场奖励的是自律，而非聪明。

quotes.en: The big money is not in the buying and selling, but in the waiting.
quotes.zh: 大钱不在买卖里，而在等待里。

quotes.en: In the short run, the market is a voting machine, but in the long run it is a weighing machine.
quotes.zh: 短期市场是投票机，长期市场是称重机。

quotes.en: Know what you own, and know why you own it.
quotes.zh: 清楚你持有什么，也清楚你为什么持有它。

quotes.en: The four most dangerous words in investing are: 'this time it's different.'
quotes.zh: 投资中最危险的四个字是：『这次不一样』。

quotes.en: Pain plus reflection equals progress.
quotes.zh: 痛苦 + 反思 = 进步。

quotes.en: It's not whether you're right or wrong, but how much money you make when you're right and how much you lose when you're wrong.
quotes.zh: 重要的不是你对还是错，而是你对的时候赚多少、错的时候亏多少。

quotes.en: There are old investors, and there are bold investors, but there are no old bold investors.
quotes.zh: 有老投资者，也有大胆的投资者，但没有又老又大胆的投资者。

quotes.en: It does not matter how slowly you go as long as you do not stop.
quotes.zh: 走得多慢没关系，只要不停下来。
quotes.who: Attributed to Confucius 传为孔子语

quotes.en: You do not rise to the level of your goals. You fall to the level of your systems.
quotes.zh: 你不会上升到目标的高度，只会跌落到系统的水平。

quotes.en: The best investment you can make is in yourself.
quotes.zh: 你能做的最好投资，是投资自己。
